# Plasmamen
Plasmamen are a species discerned by their skeletal appearance. They breathe plasma, and oxygen is highly toxic to them when inhaled. Being exposed to oxygen sets them on fire.
## Unique Abilities
### Envirosuit Shell
- To prevent ignition, they wear sealed suits made up of an envirosuit (in the jumpsuit slot) and a [bold]spaceworthy[/bold] envirosuit helmet. - Other suits like EVA suits, vacsuits, and hardsuits will also seal them from oxygen exposure.
- All Plasmamen start with an envirosuit, an envirosuit helmet, and a plasma internals tank.
- Their envirosuits contain a [color=#1e90ff]self-extinguisher[/color] with limited charges, which they can activate when they are on fire and wearing their envirosuit helmet. The self-extinguisher needs to recharge between uses.
- Their envirosuit helmets are [bold]spaceworthy[/bold] and provide welding protection. The helmet's visor can be lit up like a flashlight, using the inserted power cell as a battery. - They cannot eat nor drink without taking off their envirosuit helmet.
- The plasma internals tank lasts roughly an hour before needing to be replaced or refilled.
### Stasis Medical Treatment
- Before performing surgery on a Plasmaman, their envirosuit needs to be unequipped first, which is disastrous in an oxygenated environment.
- To get around this, the Plasmaman can be buckled to a [bold]stasis bed[/bold] before removing their envirosuit to prevent them from self-igniting throughout the surgical procedure.
- Their envirosuit helmets prevents them from eating pills, but their envirosuits allow chemicals to be injected through them.
## Plasmaman Naming Conventions
Plasmamen typically have names which have a basis upon an element or elemental compound followed by a roman numeral. Some Plasmamen also elect to take up names based off of the naming schemes of skeletons, despite it not being humerus. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Sodium V - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Nitrogen II - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Ribs C - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Sans U - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Papyrus
## Lore
It is unknown as to exactly why the Plasmaman species bears such a striking resemblance to the anatomical structure of the human species. While some suspect it is another, albeit far more extreme than normal, instance of genetic modification there is an old Plasmaman legend which claims that a powerful curse brought on by the Space Wizard Federation is their reasoning for current existence. Many Plasmamen disagree with these claims, however.
